newsitem.title: LITHUANIA: GEC Alstrom eyes Lithuanian energy sell-off - paper.
newsitem.headline: GEC Alstrom eyes Lithuanian energy sell-off - paper.

text.p: GEC Alsthom, co-owned by British General Electric and French Alcatel Alstrom, is considering investing in Lithuania's energy and transport sectors, the company told the Respublika newspaper on Thursday.

"We plan to modernise power plans in Lithuania. We know the country will need to renew its train traffic systems and electricity distribution lines as well," director of GEC Alsthom European unit Ulrich Heitmejer told the newspaper.
"We feel that the energy sector in Lithuania is being increasingly reformed and that is why we have decided to be more active here."
The Lithuanian government on Wednesday unveiled a list of key enterprises in the energy and transport sectors that it said would be put up for international tender in 1997-1998.
